checks.detail: kernel enters at the hourly close; the live bot scans every 5 min on a forming candle, so the kernel reads pumps +0.54pp larger on average (224 matched setups). DECLARED LIMITATION: arena absolute WR is not live WR. Arm-vs-arm comparisons stay valid — all arms share this kernel — but a promoted arm must still survive the earlier live entry, and that caveat is attached to every surfaced verdict.

findings.claim: Checklist item graveyard_enforced is green: '50 refutations loaded; probe naming peak-close was refused by G-01'.
findings.problem: The only evidence offered is one synthetic probe, while three arms currently in [running/confirm] sit on terms the graveyard blocks: tp-7pct is tp_pct=7.0 against G-24 (blocks 'tp7','tp=7','widen take profit', which says TP=7 survives only as a ghost, yet this arm has live_n=19 real trades); entry-8pct is pump_pct=8.0 against G-08 (blocks 'pump>=8','minimum pump size') and G-17; vol-4x is vol_threshold=4.0 against G-09 (blocks 'vol threshold','raise volume threshold'). A gate that refuses a probe but passes three live arms matching its own blocking terms is not established by the stated detail.

findings.claim: Checklist item paired_population is green and critical: 'Every arm scored on identical events — 4848 events in the shared window; every arm has seen all of them.'
findings.problem: The arena contradicts this for two arms. entry-8pct reports screen_n=498 and vol-4x reports screen_n=874, against screen_n=1560 for control and placebo. Those arms filter the detection stream, so they are not scored on identical events — they are scored on a 498- and 874-event subset. 'Has seen' is doing work that 'scored on identical events' does not survive, and every comparison of entry-8pct or vol-4x against control is therefore unpaired at the population level, which is exactly the PM failure mode the project already recorded as G-40.

findings.claim: Checklist item backfill_cannot_promote is green: 'Only live-tape evidence can promote — 0 surfaced arm(s); none promoted from a screen.'
findings.problem: Green here records that nothing has ever been surfaced, not that the rule was exercised and held; with zero surfaced arms the check cannot distinguish a working block from an untested one. Meanwhile five variant arms did advance from screen to the confirm phase, and the shared window is 4764 backfill events against 84 live, so every screen_wr, screen_ev and screen_dWR quoted in the arena — including the hold-12h screen_dWR=3.27pp and sl-5pct screen_dWR=5.26pp that justify keeping those arms alive — is overwhelmingly a backfill statistic.

findings.claim: entry-8pct and vol-4x are reported with screen_dWR=0.0pp.
findings.problem: Their own screen_wr values are 51.807 and 51.487 against control screen_wr=50.128 on the same board, so 0.0pp is not the difference in the data as displayed. The field appears to be blanked to zero for arms whose population differs rather than marked unavailable, and 0.0pp is the identical value shown by control and by the provably inert placebo — so a not-computed delta renders as a measured no-effect. Any reader ranking arms by screen_dWR reads these two as null when they are simply unmeasured.

findings.claim: Checklist item entry_granularity_declared: 'the kernel reads pumps +0.54pp larger on average (224 matched setups) ... Arm-vs-arm comparisons stay valid — all arms share this kernel.'
findings.problem: The shared-kernel argument only neutralises a bias that is orthogonal to the arm's changed parameter, and for entry-8pct it is not — that arm's single change is pump_pct=8.0, gated on the very quantity the kernel systematically inflates by 0.54pp. Its 498 scored events are the kernel's pump>=8 population, not the live bot's, so the declared limitation understates the problem for the one arm it most affects. The same objection would apply to any future pump_pct or pump_window_h arm.

findings.claim: Checklist item no_open_trades_scored and paired_population jointly account for open positions: {'control': 14, 'hold-12h': 11, 'placebo': 14, 'sl-5pct': 14, 'tp-7pct': 18, 'vol-4x': 10}, 81 trades still open.
findings.problem: entry-8pct is a [running/confirm] arm but appears nowhere in that ledger, so the open-trade audit enumerated six of the seven running arms. Those six exhaust all 81 open trades, which implies entry-8pct holds zero open positions while every other arm holds between 10 and 18 — an outcome that should be stated and checked rather than left as an omission, given the arm also reports the lowest live_n=5 and the highest declined=79.
